snippet.title: Madden 26 Official Gameplay Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Madden 26 launches on August 14. Pre-order to play 7 days early: http://x.ea.com/84425 

Built From Sundays. Madden NFL 26 brings a new AI-powered machine learning system trained by real play calls and game situations over nearly a decade to deliver more explosive gameplay—with new coach and player-specific traits, authentic play styles, and more.

Madden NFL 26 also available on Nintendo Switch 2: http://x.ea.com/84428
